curation.notes: Single-molecule fluorescence-force spectroscopy (single-trap optical tweezers + confocal smFRET): a Cy3/Cy5-labelled P. berghei CSP repeat peptide (WT or scrambled) is conjugated to DNA oligos, surface-anchored via biotin-neutravidin and pulled via a lambda-DNA handle and anti-digoxigenin bead; FRET is recorded vs force. Most of the paper is parasite cell biology (motility, RICM, infectivity).

evidence.snippet: Microscope setup consisted of a trapping laser (1064 nm, 800 mW, Spectra Physics) to catch a bead.

To apply tension, the stage was moved between 14 and 16.8 µm at a constant rate of 445 nm/s as Cy3/Cy5 emission profiles were measured with an exposure time of 20 milliseconds.

evidence.snippet: Peptides with terminal cysteines were synthesized by GenScript and diluted to 200 µM in T150 buffer: WT (C-NANDPAPPNANDPAPPNANDPAPP-C) or Scrambled (C-NNNAPDDNAAANPPANPPPPPD-C).
anti-digoxygenin-coated polystyrene beads (Polysciences) were conjugated to the peptide construct through λ-DNA of the peptide construct
the DNA-oligonucleotide, ACCGCTGCCGTCGCTCCG with a 5′ amine modification, was incubated with 200× molar excess of succinimidyl 4-[N-maleimidomethyl]cyclo-hexane-1-carboxylate
by incubation in a buffer containing 10 mM Tris HCl pH 7.5 and 150 mM NaCl for 30 min.

solution.note: Bead-conjugation buffer; the imaging buffer during pulling is not explicitly stated.
